summary: Iter27 verification. All 5 requested items work. NEW test_iter27_ai_fallback_send_errors.py passes 10/10; it mocks prospector._call and has no real email. Re-run of tests/test_fundle_brain_iter2*.py passes 55/55, after updating 2 tests (below). One real _ask call confirmed the fallback live: gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-3-flash-preview returned RateLimitError, gemini-2.5-flash answered, and both limited models were held for about 30 min. UI checks: the Prospecting banner shows 'Provider said: …' (ai-blocked-reason) when the lock is blocked. sidebar-toggle shrinks the menu from 224px to 64px and back, and sets crm_nav_mini. Collapsed nav-admin has title='Admin', is icon-only and goes to /admin. Prospecting stayed disabled, and the test lock values were removed afterwards.

minor.issue: The 'Instruction:' prefix is no longer special-cased, so the iter26 HIGH bug is fixed. But the word-overlap check still accepts a model-written reason that just repeats the user's command. Example: reason 'Instruction: set hourly cap' with user text 'set hourly cap to 25' gives words {instruction, hourly}, 1 of 2 match, so it is accepted and save_settings runs with no real WHY. Suggestion: for tools outside ACTION_TOOLS, reject reasons that start with 'instruction:'. Or require that the reason words are not all contained in the command itself.

When every model in the reduced chain fails, the last model is not added to _limited. In practice: after FLASH and 3-flash-preview are limited, each call tries only gemini-2.5-flash. If that call is rate-limited, AiCreditsOut is raised at once and the expired-limit models are not retried for up to 30 min. This is acceptable behaviour; noting it for awareness.

_send_one returns None when the doc's template was removed (_refresh_from_template returns None). _send_now then labels it 'No usable inbox…', which is misleading. Also, if a doc already has an error from an earlier attempt, that stale error is shown instead of the no-inbox reason. The unused 'sid' parameter should be removed.

issues: The 'Provider said' line is 11px at opacity-80 on a rose background. It is readable but faint; consider text-rose-700 at full opacity.

action_items: Optional: tighten _reason_ok so a reason that only repeats the command (e.g. 'Instruction: set hourly cap') doesn't pass for settings/template/data tools
Optional: in _send_now, tell 'template removed' (ok is None) apart from 'no usable inbox', and ignore stale errors from earlier attempts
critical_code_review_comments: prospector._ask: the chain [requested, FLASH, 3-flash-preview, 2.5-flash] is correct. Only quota errors trigger a fallback. _limited and _blocked live in process memory, so they reset on restart. That is fine: the first success clears the DB flag.
